observations: Torah #189 has only one bechina edge in torahData.js (עָפָר ↔ עַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת), yielding a single 2-node connected component. The framework requires 3 or more concepts forming an independent domain to propose a new package. That threshold is not met. The source text does contain a natural candidate cluster — the snake-dust-sadness-laziness quartet — but only one of its three implied bechina relationships is currently encoded. If the two missing edges were added (נשיכת הנחש ↔ עצבות ועצלות and יסוד העפר ↔ עפר), the cluster would reach the minimum size for a package proposal. At that point, a single evil-polarity package called 'נָחָשׁ וְעָפָר — עַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת (The Snake and Dust — Sadness and Laziness)' would be the appropriate candidate, capturing the teaching's core insight that all three domains — the cosmic snake, the element of dust, and the soul-states of sadness and laziness — share the same essential evil, earth-bound nature.
